scripts.dev:electron: pnpm build:main && concurrently "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron dist/electron/main/main.js"
